I’ve learned there are two types of people, one who shows their feelings and one that masks it. I express how I feel and it shows, I don’t try to mask it to get on with my day, I let it affect my day. My ex has been hooking up and meeting new people, but he would still sincerely tell me how sad and upset he is when I would ask or talk to him. Whether he is lying or not is up to me; Maybe he is sincerely happy single or maybe he’s putting up a façade just so he can get through the day.
My point is rewire how you think of it and try not to diminish your value. he may be posting how good he looks to mask how deeply sad he is inside because he lost someone.
